summary: Assess utility creditworthiness, compare finance options and prepare an actionable improvement plan. Explore this practical five-day course.
lede: Water utility finance readiness training helps utility executives and finance managers assess a provider’s preparedness for commercial or blended finance. For utility and public-sector teams, it covers creditworthiness indicators, governance and financial controls, and cash-flow forecasting in Excel. Participants compare financing options and prioritize investment and management actions in a finance-readiness improvement plan.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape water-service provider finances, governance and investment decisions, including utility, public-sector and development-partner teams.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with water-service provider operations, utility budgets or public-sector water oversight is expected. No coding or programming is required; spreadsheet familiarity supports the cash-flow exercises.
topics: Project finance, appraisal & public investment management
